title: Logout Functionality
description: Implement secure logout functionality. Add a logout button to the Dashboard UI, clear authentication tokens from local storage, and redirect the user to the login page.
requirements: Add Logout button to Dashboard sidebar or profile menu.
Ensure session is invalidated on the backend (if applicable/JWT blacklist).
implementation_notes: Logout is a client-side token removal combined with a redirect. The UI should place the logout button in a standard location (e.g., bottom of sidebar or dropdown).
